hotels.vendor_name: Hôtel Mercure Paris Centre Tour Eiffel
hotels.title: Stylish Paris Eiffel Tower Stay in the Heart of the 15th Arrondissement
hotels.description: Just a short stroll from the Eiffel Tower and the Champ de Mars, this polished Paris address places you in the 15th arrondissement, close to the Seine and the elegant avenues of the Left Bank. The nearby Bir-Hakeim bridge and Trocadéro are easy to reach on foot, while the metro opens up the city with ease. Inside, contemporary rooms offer a calm counterpoint to the capital’s grandeur, with many looking towards the tower or landscaped courtyard. Le Jardin serves French dishes in a bright setting, while the bar is a handy stop for a drink before heading to Rue Cler or the cafés of Saint-Germain-des-Prés

hotels.title: Stylish Paris Eiffel Tower Stay on the Banks of the Seine
hotels.description: On the Left Bank in the 15th arrondissement, this polished riverside retreat places you near the Eiffel Tower, Beaugrenelle’s designer boutiques and the Seine’s elegant promenades. Javel-André Citroën Metro station is a short walk away, linking you with Saint-Germain-des-Prés, the Louvre and the grand avenues of central Paris. Inside, two restaurants span refined French dining and Japanese cuisine, while the bar pours cocktails in a sleek contemporary setting. A heated indoor pool and fitness centre add to the hotel’s polished rhythm, and many rooms frame captivating views across Paris or towards the Eiffel Tower

hotels.title: Stylish Paris Bercy Stay by Pullman Near Accor Arena
hotels.description: Set in Paris’s revitalised Bercy district, this contemporary retreat places you moments from Bercy Village, where cobbled lanes lead to chic boutiques, wine bars and polished terraces. Accor Arena is a short stroll away, and the Seine’s leafy promenade invites easy walks towards Parc de Bercy’s rose gardens and sculpture-dotted lawns. Inside, sleek rooms and suites pair refined design with generous city views and marble-finished bathrooms. Dine on elegant French fare at Ariette, then linger over a cocktail at the hotel bar before taking to the indoor pool and fitness centre

hotels.title: Stylish Paris Montparnasse Escape with Contemporary Pullman Flair
hotels.description: Rising above the 14th arrondissement, this polished Paris address places you near Montparnasse station and the boutiques of Rue de Rennes. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame sweeping city views, while the sleek interiors pair contemporary design with a distinctly Parisian edge. Dine at Umami Burger Paris for gourmet burgers and cocktails, or head to Skybar Paris on the 32nd floor for panoramic views across the capital. Nearby, the Catacombs, Luxembourg Gardens and Saint-Germain-des-Prés offer a refined route through the city’s cultural heart
